new_tab.category_desc: Folders and tags you already use
new_tab.theme_desc: Hermes searches YouTube for a topic
new_tab.mixed_desc: Combine folders, tags, channels and topics

theme_build.button_tip: Hermes searches YouTube and curates a tab about any topic
theme_build.no_ai: Topic tabs need an AI model to plan the searches and curate. Pick one in Settings → Models first.
theme_build.building_tip: Hermes is still working on it. Click to see the progress.

toast.read_nothing: Nothing new to mark as read

banner.demo_arriving: Loading the demo: {count} videos from {channels} channels so far…
banner.rss_down: YouTube's feed has been unstable since {time}. Your videos keep arriving another way.
banner.rss_down_stale: YouTube's feed has been unstable since {time}. Showing what we already have.
banner.rss_fallback: {count} channels updated from the channel page
banner.ext_disconnected: Browser extension disconnected — new subscriptions and watch history won't sync.
banner.ext_not_paired: Connect the browser extension to bring in your subscriptions

empty.tab_desc: Nothing new in {tab}. New videos show up here as soon as the channels post.
empty.search_desc: Search looks at video titles and channel names across this whole tab.
empty.search_loaded_desc: Nothing among the loaded videos matches “{query}”.
empty.filter_desc: No loaded video passes these filters.
empty.later_desc: Press L on any video (or the clock button) to keep it here.

welcome.lead: Pick a way to start. You can add the others later.
welcome.pair_desc: Brings in all your subscriptions and watch history from your browser — no password, nothing leaves your machine.
welcome.link_desc: Paste a channel link or an @handle to follow it here without subscribing on YouTube.
welcome.demo_desc: 40 real public channels in 6 folders, to explore before connecting anything.
welcome.link_hint: Channel or video link, @handle or channel id (UC…). Press Enter to follow.

errors.empty: Paste a channel link or @handle first.
errors.invalid: That doesn't look like a YouTube channel link or @handle.
errors.conflict_generic: That channel is already in your list.
errors.youtube_error: YouTube couldn't find that channel. Check the link and try again.
errors.timeout: YouTube took too long to answer. Try again in a moment.

tab_menu.delete_desc: Its channels, folders and videos stay as they are — only the tab goes away.

playlists.label: Your playlists
playlists.empty_desc: Use Add to playlist on any video to start one.
playlists.delete_desc: Only the playlist goes away. Its videos stay in your subscriptions and in any other playlist.
playlists.playlist_empty_desc: Use Add to playlist on any video to put it here.
playlists.local_note: Kept in HermesTube on this computer, not on your YouTube account.
